mapper.select: select mn.Bdd_Id as budgetId, mn.select_Amount as selectAmount, ibdd.Bdd_Parent_Id as budgetParentId, sec.Sec_Id as secId, con.Con_Id as conId, con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, con.Con_Reserve_Money as conReserveMoney, ibdd.Bdd_Total as bddTotal, con.Con_Bid_Document as conBidDocument from Sec_Info_Budget_Declare_Dtl mn left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id left join Inv_Budget_Declare_Dtl ibdd on mn.Bdd_Id = ibdd.Bdd_Id left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Section_Id = sec.Sec_Id where mn.Bdd_Id=#{sibCost} and sec.Sec_Flow_State=7 and con.Con_Approval_State=7
